findings.obs_text: In 1Sa 18:17 Saul tells David to fight the Lord's battles while he thinks to let the Philistines kill him: the fighting is the cover of the thought. In 2Ki 18:20 and Isa 36:5 the Rabshakeh asks whether they think mere words are strategy for war. In Mic 2:8 with no thought of war renders a turning back, not a thought.
findings.grounds: Only be valiant for me and fight

findings.obs_text: In Psa 119:52 thinking of the Lord's rules from of old brings comfort: the remembering is the ground of the comfort. In Job 12:5 the thought of one at ease holds contempt for misfortune: ease shapes the thought.
findings.grounds: When I think of your rules from of old, I take comfort

findings.obs_text: In Num 36:6 the Lord commands that the daughters marry whom they think best within the clan: their judgment is free inside the command. In 1Ch 29:18 David asks the Lord to keep such thoughts in the hearts of his people and direct their hearts. In Psa 50:21 the Lord lays the charge before those who thought him like themselves. In Rom 12:3 sober thinking is by the measure God has assigned, and in 1Cor 14:37 the one who thinks he is spiritual is to acknowledge the Lord's command.
findings.grounds: Let them marry whom they think best

findings.obs_text: In Phili 4:8 whatever is worthy of praise is among what the believers are to think about: the thinking is turned to what is commendable.
findings.grounds: if there is anything worthy of praise

findings.obs_text: In Isa 55:7 the unrighteous man is to forsake his thoughts and return to the Lord, who will have compassion on him: forsaking the thoughts opens the way to mercy. In Pro 15:26 gracious words stand against the thoughts of the wicked.
In 1Ti 3:7 the overseer must be well thought of by outsiders: the requirement is a good report from others, not a thought of his own.
findings.grounds: he must be well thought of by outsiders

findings.obs_text: In Gen 38:15 Judah took Tamar for a prostitute because she had covered her face: what is hidden leads the thought astray. In 2Ki 7:12 the king thinks the Syrians hide to trap them, and in Psa 64:5 the wicked lay snares secretly, thinking none will see. In Dan 2:30 and Luk 2:35 the thoughts are revealed: what is hidden in the heart is brought out.
findings.grounds: so that thoughts from many hearts may be revealed
